00053 // The following ifdef block is the standard way of creating macros which make exporting 
00054 // from a DLL simpler. All files within this DLL are compiled with the FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00055 // symbol defined on the command line. this symbol should not be defined on any project
00056 // that uses this DLL. This way any other project whose source files include this file see 
00057 // DLL_API functions as being imported from a DLL, wheras this DLL sees symbols
00058 // defined with this macro as being exported.
00059 #ifdef FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00060 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllexport)
00061 #else
00062 #define DLL_API __declspec(dllimport)
00063 #endif // FREEIMAGE_EXPORTS
00064 #endif // FREEIMAGE_LIB || !WIN32
00065 
00066 // Some versions of gcc may have BYTE_ORDER or __BYTE_ORDER defined
00067 // If your big endian system isn't being detected, add an OS specific check
00068 #if (defined(BYTE_ORDER) && BYTE_ORDER==BIG_ENDIAN) || \
00069         (defined(__BYTE_ORDER) && __BYTE_ORDER==__BIG_ENDIAN) || \
00070         defined(__APPLE__)
00071 #define FREEIMAGE_BIGENDIAN
00072 #endif // BYTE_ORDER

00176 // Indexes for byte arrays, masks and shifts for treating pixels as words ---
00177 // These coincide with the order of RGBQUAD and RGBTRIPLE -------------------
00178 
00179 #ifndef FREEIMAGE_BIGENDIAN
00180 // Little Endian (x86 / MS Windows, Linux) : BGR(A) order
00181 #define FI_RGBA_RED                             2
00182 #define FI_RGBA_GREEN                   1
00183 #define FI_RGBA_BLUE                    0
00184 #define FI_RGBA_ALPHA                   3
00185 #define FI_RGBA_RED_MASK                0x00FF0000
00186 #define FI_RGBA_GREEN_MASK              0x0000FF00
00187 #define FI_RGBA_BLUE_MASK               0x000000FF
00188 #define FI_RGBA_ALPHA_MASK              0xFF000000
00189 #define FI_RGBA_RED_SHIFT               16
00190 #define FI_RGBA_GREEN_SHIFT             8
00191 #define FI_RGBA_BLUE_SHIFT              0
00192 #define FI_RGBA_ALPHA_SHIFT             24
00193 #else
00194 // Big Endian (PPC / Linux, MaxOSX) : RGB(A) order
00195 #define FI_RGBA_RED                             0
00196 #define FI_RGBA_GREEN                   1
00197 #define FI_RGBA_BLUE                    2
00198 #define FI_RGBA_ALPHA                   3
00199 #define FI_RGBA_RED_MASK                0xFF000000
00200 #define FI_RGBA_GREEN_MASK              0x00FF0000
00201 #define FI_RGBA_BLUE_MASK               0x0000FF00
00202 #define FI_RGBA_ALPHA_MASK              0x000000FF
00203 #define FI_RGBA_RED_SHIFT               24
00204 #define FI_RGBA_GREEN_SHIFT             16
00205 #define FI_RGBA_BLUE_SHIFT              8
00206 #define FI_RGBA_ALPHA_SHIFT             0
00207 #endif // FREEIMAGE_BIGENDIAN
00208 
00209 #define FI_RGBA_RGB_MASK                (FI_RGBA_RED_MASK|FI_RGBA_GREEN_MASK|FI_RGBA_BLUE_MASK)
00210 
00211 // The 16bit macros only include masks and shifts, since each color element is not byte aligned
00212 
00213 #define FI16_555_RED_MASK               0x7C00
00214 #define FI16_555_GREEN_MASK             0x03E0
00215 #define FI16_555_BLUE_MASK              0x001F
00216 #define FI16_555_RED_SHIFT              10
00217 #define FI16_555_GREEN_SHIFT    5
00218 #define FI16_555_BLUE_SHIFT             0
00219 #define FI16_565_RED_MASK               0xF800
00220 #define FI16_565_GREEN_MASK             0x07E0
00221 #define FI16_565_BLUE_MASK              0x001F
00222 #define FI16_565_RED_SHIFT              11
00223 #define FI16_565_GREEN_SHIFT    5
00224 #define FI16_565_BLUE_SHIFT             0
